task.title: Open Compare from the Library
task.shortdesc: Open the dedicated Compare surface in a new tab before selecting two saved profiles.

prereq.p: The Profile Library is open and at least two saved profiles exist.

context.p: Compare is a dedicated saved-profile surface. It keeps the current language and theme and does not replace the Library tab.

step.cmd: Choose the Compare profiles action in the Library.

info.p: Expected result: BPM opens the Compare interface in a new browser tab.

step.cmd: Use the left and right search fields to choose Profile A and Profile B.

info.note: Compare reads saved profile state. Save editor changes before relying on the comparison.

result.p: The Compare surface is ready for independent Profile A and Profile B selection.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the Compare tab opens without expected profiles, return to the Library, refresh it, and confirm both profiles are saved and visible.
